description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuing Certificate of Exemption for distributing Electricity
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory matter issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). It concerns the issuance of a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution, which falls under regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel/structure changes.
